body.text:

  "objective": "visits",

  "gender": "all",

  "headline": "Confira nossa oferta",
  "primaryText": "Texto principal do an\u00fancio",
  "imageUrl": "https://example.com/imagem.jpg",
  "pageId": "248051691715153",
  "durationDays": 30
}
